trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it unlocks automatically once you have earned the other 54 trophies on the list, so there is nothing separate to do for it. Work through the roadmap in order — story, stranger strands, activities, then collectibles and clean-up — and this one lands last. The official description says it all: you are a Leonida Legend. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, which is the first story mission of the game. Just play the story from the start and follow the mission prompts; this one cannot be missed. It pops as soon as the mission ends. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 by playing through its story missions in order. There is no special requirement beyond finishing the chapter's missions, so keep following the story. It unlocks when the chapter closes. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 by playing through its story missions in order. Keep following the story after Chapter 1 and this unlocks when the chapter ends. Nothing here can be missed. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 by playing through its story missions in order. It unlocks when the chapter closes, with no extra requirement. Just keep pushing the story forward. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 by playing through its story missions in order. It unlocks when the chapter closes, with no extra requirement. You will be most of the way through the story by this point. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. This is the gold trophy for finishing the main story, so play through the chapters in order until the finale. It unlocks when the final mission ends; free-roam clean-up comes after. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Play the story in order and this unlocks when the mission ends; there is no extra requirement in the official description. It cannot be missed. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Play the story in order and this unlocks when the mission ends; the official description asks for nothing more. It cannot be missed. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Play the story in order and this unlocks when the mission ends; the official description asks for nothing more. It cannot be missed. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Play the story in order and this unlocks when the mission ends; the official description asks for nothing more. It cannot be missed. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Play the story in order and this unlocks when the mission ends; the official description asks for nothing more. It cannot be missed. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Play the story in order and this unlocks when the mission ends; the official description asks for nothing more. It cannot be missed. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, which means finishing everything the game counts toward completion: story, stranger strands, activities, and collectibles. Treat this as the clean-up trophy — it comes naturally once the rest of the roadmap is done. The exact checklist the game uses is not public yet, so check the in-game stats page as you go. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, flips, and other stunt moves the game tracks. The count is cumulative, so build it up over the whole playthrough rather than grinding it in one sitting. Use stunt jumps and ramps you find while exploring; the official description gives the total of 250. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — sampling everything the game offers, from races and fishing to the shooting range and arcade games, counts toward this. The official description gives no fixed list or count, so try every activity type you come across and the trophy should pop when the last new type is sampled. The full activity roster is not public yet. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. Head to the shooting range and work through its challenges, replaying any that fall short of gold until they clear. The official description gives no count of challenges, so the exact total is not public yet. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location that hosts one. Race drones at each Top Fun spot across Leonida until you have a win at all of them; the official description gives no count of locations, so the exact total is not public yet. A win at each location is what counts, not a single race. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter races around Leonida — each distinct race you win counts once, so vary your picks rather than repeating the same one. The count is 20 wins across different races, per the official description. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find the fishing challenge against Cal and out-fish him; the official description says nothing about a one-chance meeting, so it should be replayable if you lose the first time. Exact fishing spots and Cal's schedule are not public yet. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — play one through to its end at an arcade machine. Any single arcade game counts, so pick the shortest one you find. The official description gives no specific title, so the arcade lineup is not public yet. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy, one of the stranger mission strands across Leonida. Find Andy, work through his strand of missions, and this unlocks when his last one ends. Stranger strands stay available in free roam, so nothing here is missable. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton, one of the stranger mission strands across Leonida. Find Kenton, work through his strand of missions, and this unlocks when his last one ends. Stranger strands stay available in free roam, so nothing here is missable. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy, one of the stranger mission strands across Leonida. Find Billy, work through his strand of missions, and this unlocks when his last one ends. Stranger strands stay available in free roam, so nothing here is missable. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Each stranger you meet has a strand of missions; finish eight full strands and this silver trophy pops. The named strangers in this list — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, and Bret — cover most of them, so keep an eye out for the rest. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy, one of the stranger mission strands across Leonida. Find Randy, work through his strand of missions, and this unlocks when his last one ends. Stranger strands stay available in free roam, so nothing here is missable. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone, one of the stranger mission strands across Leonida. Find Tyrone, work through his strand of missions, and this unlocks when his last one ends. Stranger strands stay available in free roam, so nothing here is missable. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. Visit each spot and meditate there; the official description gives no count of spots, so the exact total is not public yet. Treat this as a clean-up collectible and sweep the map in free roam after the story. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret, one of the stranger contacts. Take the hunt Bret offers and bring down the unique animal he wants; the official description gives no species or location, so those details are not public yet. This is a stranger-linked activity rather than a story mission. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Find and collect the cards scattered around Leonida until three full sets are complete; the official description gives the target of 3 sets. This is a long clean-up job, best done in free roam after the story. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — use the WAiNK feature at 100 distinct spots across Leonida. The count is 100 locations, per the official description, and it is cumulative, so tick them off as you explore. Exact spot locations are not public yet. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Work through the game's challenge list — 50 completions, per the official description — picking the easiest ones first. The full challenge list is not public yet, so check the in-game challenges menu as you play. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the heat dies down. Your partner is the other protagonist, who is with you through the story and free roam, so this can be attempted again if it fails. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row while keeping the wanted level alive between robberies — do not let the heat drop to zero until the third is done. Your partner needs to be with you; it can be retried if the wanted level drops. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or encounter 100 distinct vehicles across Leonida — the count is 100, per the official description — and each new model you find adds to the total. Sweep car parks, traffic, and showrooms during clean-up. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with at least five enemies in range and drop all five before it ends. Pick a busy fight and save this for a moment with plenty of targets; it can be retried freely. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave Vice City International Airport in a way that is not a scheduled flight. The official description gives no exact method, so the trigger is not public yet; the name points to a stunt-style exit from the airport. Try it in free roam once you can reach VCIA. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The official description only hints at Rhinos — the tanks — with the line 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos.' The exact trigger is not public yet; it likely involves a Rhino tank, whether driving one or dealing with one. Watch the trophy listings for the confirmed method once the game is out. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan the robbery quietly — stay out of sight, avoid alarms and cameras — and get out clean. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, but you can try again. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Hit five bank vaults and get away clean after each one; the count is 5, per the official description. Each vault robbery and escape counts separately, so work through them across free roam. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, rob it, and escape with the heat off you. One successful truck robbery and escape is all it takes. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — visit every area of the map until the whole state is uncovered. The official description gives no count of areas, so the exact total is not public yet. This is a clean-up sweep best done in free roam after the story, using the in-game map to spot uncovered ground. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Find and rob one illegal operation per gang across Leonida; the official description gives no count of gangs, so the exact total is not public yet. Work through the gangs one at a time in free roam. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, find a spot with a view, and have a cocktail there. The trophy's name hints at doing it early, but the official description sets no one-chance condition, so it should still be possible later in the game. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Get a vehicle inside a showroom and crash out through the front — the description calls for a smash-out, so subtlety is not the aim. One clean smash-out is all it takes. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Visit the bowling alley and bowl — the description points to a proper follow-through, so play a frame rather than just walking in. The alley's exact location is not public yet. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The official description is cryptic — 'A partnership with mass appeal.' — and gives no concrete action, so the exact trigger is not public yet. The name and text point to a partnership moment involving the two protagonists, likely one that draws a crowd. Watch the trophy listings for the confirmed method once the game is out. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse) — this trophy is tied to the choices you make during the story. Because a choice, once made, cannot be unmade on the same playthrough, this is the one missable trophy on the list: keep a backup save before any big story decision so you can return to it. The official description gives no count or list of choices, so the exact requirements are not public yet. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — this one is about succeeding on a second attempt after a first failure. The official description gives no specific event, so the exact trigger is not public yet; the wording suggests failing something once, then succeeding at it on the retry. Watch the trophy listings for the confirmed method once the game is out. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The official description — 'What the hell just happened?' — gives no concrete action, so the exact trigger is not public yet. The name points to a hidden or strange event somewhere in Leonida, the kind of secret usually found during clean-up exploration. Watch the trophy listings for the confirmed method once the game is out. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Drive past a target and land a melee hit from the vehicle; the description is a bowling pun, but the act is a drive-by with a melee weapon. It can be retried freely. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills via your contacts until the total hits $250,000, per the official description — the amount is cumulative. Keep laundering as bills come in and the total will build over the playthrough. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy goods across the shops of Leonida until total spending reaches $100,000, per the official description — the amount is cumulative across every shop. It builds naturally over a full playthrough. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property on offer; the official description gives no count, so the exact total is not public yet. Save this for clean-up, when you have the cash to buy up the remaining properties. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the Scooter Bros app to register vehicles until you reach 10, per the official description. Any ten vehicles count, so register the ones you find as you explore. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
